en.title: Electric Dirt Bikes for Kids: What to Check
en.content:
"Electric dirt bike for kids" is a search that lands in a category with no dirt bike in it. This guide covers what the off-road ride-on toys in this catalog actually publish, what they leave out, and the checks to run on a dirt-bike-shaped ride-on wherever you end up buying one.

## What the catalog holds

The catalog files 17 listings under the electric ride-on category. The category page shows 25 products in total, because it also pulls in push ride-ons and kick scooters whose copy matches the electric boundary; one of the seventeen is a helmet listing the category page does not show, so every count below covers the other sixteen. Four of those sixteen are off-road shaped:

- **A 6V three-wheel kids electric motorcycle** — the only one in the catalog — with police decals, reverse and headlights. 16.8 lb, 55 lb capacity, ages 3-5, plastic, assembly required.
- **A 24V two-seater licensed Bronco Raptor** — 132 lb capacity, ages 3-8, metal and PP plastic, assembly required.
- **A 36V two-seater UTV** with a 400W motor — its title states 5-8 MPH and 14-inch EVA wheels; its spec sheet states 132 lb capacity and 37-120 months, while the title says 6+. Metal frame, assembly required.
- **A 24V two-seater licensed F-150** with 4x100W all-terrain motors — 60.6 lb, 65 lb capacity, ages 3-8, 122 minutes of stated battery life, assembly required.

None of the four is a dirt bike: no kids dirt bike listing, no pedal-assist e-bike and no off-road motorcycle beyond the 6V three-wheeler above appears in this catalog. What follows is about the gap between what that search expects and what this category publishes.

## The publication gap

Counting all 16 listings in the electric ride-on category:

- Voltage appears in 15 of 16 titles — 12V eight times, 24V five times, 36V once, 6V once; the one without a stated voltage is a wiggle car.
- Top speed appears in 0 of 16 spec sheets. The speeds that exist — 1.5, 3.5, 4 and 5-8 MPH — are title copy on four listings, not published specs.
- Braking appears in 0 of 16 spec sheets.
- Tire type appears in 0 of 16 spec sheets; the only tire material stated anywhere in the category is the UTV's 14-inch EVA wheels, in its title, and one other title states an 8-inch tire with no material at all.
- Motor wattage appears in 0 of 16 spec sheets; the 400W, 4x100W and twin-35W figures are title copy.
- Parental remote control appears in 11 of 16 titles but only 3 of 16 spec sheets.
- Battery life is stated in 10 of 16 spec sheets; no listing states a charging time.
- Weight capacity is stated in 14 of 16 spec sheets, and the stated values run from 55 lb to 264 lb.
- All sixteen state a minimum age; 14 of those start at 36 months or later, and the two outliers start at 18 and 12 months.
- Assembly is required by all sixteen.

So the one powertrain number this category publishes consistently — voltage — is the one that says least about how a ride-on behaves, and the numbers that describe the ride itself (speed, braking, tires, motor power) live in title copy where they cannot be compared.

## Five checks before it goes off-road

1. **Read voltage as a speed class, not a spec.** In this category two 12V titles state 1.5 and 3.5 MPH in title copy, a wiggle car with no stated voltage states 4 MPH, and the 36V UTV states 5-8 MPH. Voltage sets the ceiling; it does not tell you the limit the manufacturer actually ships.
2. **Tires before terrain.** EVA foam cannot puncture and transmits what it rolls over; pneumatic tyres grip and need air. The only tire material stated in the whole category is the UTV's EVA, in its title. On dirt, this is the first thing to check in person.
3. **Verify the parental control exists as hardware.** Eleven of sixteen titles mention a remote; three of sixteen spec sheets state one. Ask whether the remote is included, what it controls — speed, direction, or both — and its range.
4. **Match capacity to rider plus gear.** The off-road cluster states 55-132 lb, and the 6V motorcycle's 55 lb is the tightest in the category. A rider at the limit has no margin for a jacket, let alone a passenger.
5. **Check the age floor against your child.** All sixteen listings state a minimum, and 14 of those start at 36 months or later. A three-year-old on a 24V two-seater is inside the stated range; a two-year-old is below it on all but one listing in the category. The tier-by-tier floors are in [Kids Electric Bikes 2026: Voltage by Age](/news/industry/kids-electric-bike-development-trends-2026).

## What this catalog does not list

No dirt-bike-shaped electric ride-on, no pedal-assist e-bike, and no off-road motorcycle beyond the 6V three-wheeler above. If a listing elsewhere promises dirt-bike performance, the five checks above are the ones to put to it — and the [electric ride-on category](/products/electric-cars/) shows what a published spec sheet looks like in this market.

## Method and limits

Every figure is counted from this site's published catalog — the 16 listings filed under the electric ride-on category, October 2026. Nothing here is measured by us; where a listing does not state a spec, this page reports it as not stated. Titles are retailer copy and change without notice, so verify against the current listing before buying.

zh.title: 儿童电动越野车选购：先核对这五项
zh.content:
搜"儿童电动越野车"，落进来的却是一个目录里没有越野车的品类。这篇讲清楚：儿童电动车这个品类里，越野骑乘玩具公布了什么、没公布什么，以及不管最后在哪买，都能带着去核对的五件事。

## 目录里有什么

目录里归在电动骑乘品类下的有 17 个车型。品类页实际展示 25 个产品——它还揽入了文案匹配电动边界的推行骑乘车与脚踏滑板车；17 个里有一个是品类页不展示的头盔车型，所以下面的每个数字都数其余 16 个。16 个里有 4 个是越野造型：

- **6V 三轮儿童电动摩托车**——目录里唯一一辆——带警用贴花、倒挡、车灯。16.8 磅，承重 55 磅，3-5 岁，塑料件，需组装。
- **24V 双座 licensed Bronco Raptor**——承重 132 磅，3-8 岁，金属与 PP 塑料，需组装。
- **36V 双座 UTV**，400W 电机——标题写 5-8 MPH、14 英寸 EVA 轮；规格表写承重 132 磅、37-120 个月，而标题写 6 岁以上。金属车架，需组装。
- **24V 双座 licensed F-150**，4x100W 全地形电机——60.6 磅，承重 65 磅，3-8 岁，标称续航 122 分钟，需组装。

四款都不是越野摩托车。本站目录没有越野造型的骑乘车，也没有踏板助力电动自行车，这篇不假装有——下面讲的是这类搜索的期待和这个品类的公布现状之间的落差。

## 公布的落差

数完电动骑乘品类全部 16 个车型：

- 电压出现在 15/16 个标题里——12V 八次、24V 五次、36V 一次、6V 一次；没标电压的那个是一辆扭扭车。
- 最高时速出现在 0/16 个规格表里。存在的速度——1.5、3.5、4 和 5-8 MPH——是四个车型标题里的文案，不是公布的规格。
- 制动出现在 0/16 个规格表里。
- 轮胎类型出现在 0/16 个规格表里；全品类唯一标出的轮胎材质是 UTV 标题里的 14 英寸 EVA，另有一个标题只标了 8 英寸轮胎尺寸，没标材质。
- 电机功率出现在 0/16 个规格表里；400W、4x100W 和双 35W 都是标题文案。
- 家长遥控出现在 11/16 个标题里，但只有 3/16 个规格表里。
- 续航写在 10/16 个规格表里；没有一个车型标了充电时间。
- 承重写在 14/16 个规格表里，标称值从 55 磅到 264 磅。
- 16 个全部标了最低年龄；其中 14 个从 36 个月起，两个例外从 18 和 12 个月起。
- 16 个全部需要组装。

所以这个品类唯一公布得一致的动力数字——电压——恰恰是对骑行行为说明最少的那一个，而描述骑行本身的数字（速度、制动、轮胎、电机功率）都住在无法互相比较的标题文案里。

## 上非铺装路面前的五项核对

1. **把电压当速度档位读，不当规格读。** 这个品类里两辆 12V 车型在标题里分别写 1.5 和 3.5 MPH，一辆没标电压的扭扭车写 4 MPH，36V UTV 写 5-8 MPH。电压定的是上限，不告诉你厂商实际发货的限速。
2. **先看轮胎，再看地形。** EVA 发泡扎不破，但路面反馈直接传导；充气胎抓地好，但要打气。全品类唯一标出的轮胎材质就是 UTV 标题里的 EVA。走非铺装路面，这是到手第一件该用眼睛查的事。
3. **把家长遥控当硬件核实。** 16 个标题里 11 个提到遥控，16 个规格表里只有 3 个写了。要问清：遥控是否随附、控制什么——速度、方向还是两者——以及遥控距离。
4. **承重要罩住骑乘的人加装备。** 越野簇标称 55-132 磅，其中 6V 摩托车的 55 磅是全品类最紧的。贴着上限骑的人，连一件外套的余量都没有，更别说带人。
5. **最低年龄对照自家孩子。** 16 个车型全部标了最低年龄，其中 14 个从 36 个月起。三岁孩子上 24V 双座在标称范围内；两岁孩子在除一个车型外的全部车型之下。逐档的年龄下限见[儿童电动自行车 2026：电压与年龄对照](/news/industry/kids-electric-bike-development-trends-2026)。

## 本站目录没有列出的

没有越野造型的电动骑乘车，没有踏板助力电动自行车，除那辆 6V 三轮外也没有越野摩托车。如果别处的 Listing 承诺越野性能，就用上面五项去核对——而[电动骑乘品类页](/products/electric-cars/)可以看到这个市场里一份公布齐全的规格表长什么样。

## 方法与边界

这里每个数字都数自本站已发布目录（2026 年 10 月）——归在电动骑乘品类下的 16 个车型。没有任何一项是我们测量的；Listing 没标的规格，本页就报"未标"。标题是零售商文案，会随时变动，下单前请对照当时的 Listing 再核一遍。

zh.title: 儿童电动自行车 2026：电压与年龄对照
zh.content:
搜"儿童电动自行车"，想要的是带电机和脚踏的自行车。本站目录里没有——儿童电动车这个品类下收录的是汽车、卡车、一台 UTV、两辆扭扭车和一辆三轮摩托车，全目录没有任何一辆踏板助力电动自行车。所以这里不写行业趋势，只写一件本站能用自己的发布数据记下的 2026 事实：电动骑乘品类各档位公布了什么，以及公布到哪里停。

## 电压阶梯

归在电动骑乘品类下的有 17 个车型。品类页实际展示 25 个产品——它还揽入了文案匹配电动边界的推行骑乘车与脚踏滑板车；17 个里有一个是品类页不展示的头盔车型，所以下面的每个数字都数其余 16 个。16 个标题里 15 个标了电压——12V 八次、24V 五次、36V 一次、6V 一次。没标电压的那个是一辆扭扭车。

- **6V——一个车型。** 带警用贴花、倒挡、车灯的三轮摩托车。标称年龄 36-60 个月，承重 55 磅，单座，需组装。
- **12V——八个车型。** 主力档：授权皮卡、一台三合一推行骑乘车、一台幼儿骑乘车和两辆扭扭车。标称最低年龄 12-36 个月；标了承重的为 61-132 磅。八个标题里六个提到家长遥控。
- **24V——五个车型。** 双座和更大的车架，标称承重 65-264 磅——264 磅属于一台四座车，是全品类最高的标称承重。五个标题全部提到家长遥控。
- **36V——一个车型。** 双座 UTV，400W 电机。标题写 5-8 MPH、14 英寸 EVA 轮；规格表写承重 132 磅、37-120 个月。

## 电压不是年龄

这个阶梯最有用的属性也最容易骗人。单是 12V 一档，标称最低年龄从 12 个月横跨到 36 个月，标称最高年龄从 36 个月横跨到 12 年——同一个电压徽标既贴在幼儿骑乘车上，也贴在承重 132 磅的车上。电压定的是动力上限，不说明这车是给多大的孩子造的。说明这件事的是年龄行和承重行，而这两行都在规格表里，不在标题里。

16 个车型全部标了最低年龄。其中 14 个从 36 个月起，两个例外从 12 和 18 个月起，都在 12V 档。

## 公布停在哪里

数同样的 16 个车型：最高时速没有出现在任何规格表里——存在的速度 1.5 MPH、3.5 MPH、4 MPH 和 5-8 MPH，是四个车型标题里的文案。制动、轮胎类型和电机功率同样不出现在任何规格表里；400W、4x100W 和双 35W 都是标题文案。家长遥控出现在 11/16 个标题里，却只有 3/16 个规格表里。电池平均寿命写在 10 个规格表里，承重 14 个——55 磅到 264 磅——16 个全部需要组装。没有一个车型标了充电时间。

## 可以带走的三项核对

1. **先对年龄下限，再对电压。** 一辆标了 36 个月下限的 12V 车，不会因为和某辆幼儿车同一个电压就变成幼儿车。
2. **承重要罩住骑乘的人加乘客。** 双座车标称 65-264 磅；买给两个孩子之前先把这数字分一半。全品类最紧的标称承重是 55 磅，在那辆 6V 摩托车上。
3. **规格表不复述的数字，都先当营销看。** 电压、速度、电机功率、遥控在标题里出现的频率和规格表完全对不上。找卖家对着当时的 Listing 核一遍。

## 方法与边界

这里每个数字都数自本站已发布目录（2026 年 10 月）——归在电动骑乘品类下的 16 个车型。没有任何一项是我们测量的；Listing 没标的规格，本页就报"未标"。标题是零售商文案，会随时变动，下单前请对照当时的 Listing 再核一遍。

en.title: Kids Electric Bikes 2026: Voltage by Age
en.content:
"Kids electric bike" is a search for a bicycle with a motor and pedals. This catalog lists no pedal-assist e-bike — what it lists under the electric ride-on category is cars, trucks, a UTV, two wiggle cars and a three-wheel motorcycle. So instead of e-bike trends coverage, here is the one 2026 trend this site can document from its own published data: what the electric lineup states, tier by tier, and where the stated numbers stop.

## The voltage ladder

Seventeen listings carry the electric ride-on category tag. The category page shows 25 products in total, because it also pulls in push ride-ons and kick scooters whose copy matches the electric boundary; one of the seventeen is a helmet listing the category page does not show, so every count below covers the other sixteen. Fifteen of those sixteen titles state a voltage — 12V eight times, 24V five times, 36V once, 6V once. The one that does not is a wiggle car.

- **6V — one listing.** A three-wheel motorcycle with police decals, reverse and headlights. Stated age 36-60 months, 55 lb capacity, single seat, assembly required.
- **12V — eight listings.** The workhorse tier: licensed trucks, a 3-in-1 push ride-on, a toddler ride-on and two wiggle cars. Stated minimum ages run 12-36 months; where capacity is stated it runs 61-132 lb. Six of the eight titles mention a parental remote.
- **24V — five listings.** Two-seaters and larger frames, with stated capacities of 65-264 lb — the 264 lb figure belongs to a four-seater, the highest stated capacity in the category. All five titles mention a parental remote.
- **36V — one listing.** A two-seater UTV with a 400W motor. Its title states 5-8 MPH and 14-inch EVA wheels; its spec sheet states 132 lb capacity and 37-120 months.

## Voltage is not an age

The ladder's most useful property is also its most misleading one. The 12V tier alone spans stated minimum ages from 12 to 36 months and stated maximum ages from 36 months to 12 years — the same voltage badge sits on a toddler ride-on and on a 132 lb-capacity car. Voltage sets a power ceiling; it does not say which child the listing is built for. The age line and the capacity line do that, and both live in the spec sheet rather than the title.

All sixteen listings state a minimum age. Fourteen of them start at 36 months or later; the two outliers start at 12 and 18 months, both in the 12V tier.

## Where the stated numbers stop

Counting the same sixteen listings: top speed appears in no spec sheet — the speeds that exist, 1.5 MPH, 3.5 MPH, 4 MPH and 5-8 MPH, are title copy on four listings. Braking, tire type and motor wattage appear in no spec sheet either; the 400W, 4x100W and twin-35W figures are title copy. Parental remote control appears in 11 of 16 titles but only 3 of 16 spec sheets. Battery average life is stated in 10 spec sheets and weight capacity in 14 — 55 lb to 264 lb — and all sixteen require assembly. No listing states a charging time.

## Three checks that transfer

1. **Match the age floor first, the voltage second.** A 12V listing with a 36-month floor is not a toddler product because it shares a voltage with one that is.
2. **Check capacity against rider plus passenger.** The two-seaters state 65-264 lb; split that number before buying for two children. The tightest stated capacity in the category is 55 lb, on the 6V motorcycle.
3. **Treat title numbers as marketing until the spec sheet repeats them.** Voltage, speed, motor power and remote presence all appear in titles at rates the spec sheets do not match. Ask the seller to confirm against the current listing.

## Method and limits

Every figure is counted from this site's published catalog — the 16 listings filed under the electric ride-on category, October 2026. Nothing here is measured by us; where a listing does not state a spec, this page reports it as not stated. Titles are retailer copy and change without notice, so verify against the current listing before buying.

en.title: 2026 Kids' Ride-On Safety Standard Updates
en.content:
The biggest change to kids' ride-on safety rules in years landed in Europe this year, and it puts balance bikes under a dedicated set of test clauses for the first time. Here is what changed on both sides of the Atlantic, what it means for balance bikes specifically, and how to check a bike against the current rules.

## Europe: EN 71-1:2026 gives balance bikes their own clauses

On 28 January 2026, the European Committee for Standardization (CEN) distributed the new edition of EN 71-1, the mechanical and physical performance half of the EU toy safety standards. It replaces EN 71-1:2014+A1:2018.

The headline change for this site: ride-on toys — bicycles, balance bikes, and scooters — were gathered into a single clause (8.21) with eleven subclauses, five of them new tests:

1. **Handlebar end impact.** Each handlebar end is struck against a hard surface ten times.
2. **Brake performance.** Brakes are judged against force tables, with input forces of 40, 50, and 60 N applied step by step, rather than a single distance measurement.
3. **Handlebar stem security.** A torque of 10 N·m is held for one minute.
4. **Stabilizer strength.** A 300 N load on each stabilizer wheel, with deflection and permanent-set limits.
5. **Saddle and seat-post security.** A vertical load of 200 N on the saddle.

Balance bikes specifically gain requirements the standard previously did not spell out: clearance dimensions, minimum front-wheel diameter, handlebar dimensions, brake requirements, minimum insertion-depth marks for adjustable stems and seat posts, clamping requirements, and stability plus static and dynamic strength tests — along with new requirements for warnings, labels, and maintenance instructions.

The timeline: national standards bodies had until 31 July 2026 to adopt EN 71-1:2026, and conflicting national standards must be withdrawn by 31 July 2027. The edition is expected to be approved by the European Commission roughly twelve months after publication, at which point it becomes a harmonized standard under the Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC — the version that carries legal weight in the EU market. Until that approval, CE marking runs through the previous edition and its amendments.

## The United States: no 2026 overhaul, but know your bike's classification

Nothing changed in US federal rules this year. What matters for buyers is understanding which rules a balance bike falls under — and it is not always obvious, because a balance bike has no pedals:

- **Sidewalk bikes.** CPSC generally treats a balance bike with a seat height of 25 inches (63.5 cm) or less as a "sidewalk bike" under 16 CFR 1512. That classification reduces — but does not remove — requirements.
- **CPSIA.** Lead limits (90 ppm in paint, 100 ppm in substrate), phthalate limits, and the permanent tracking label apply to every children's product, including balance bikes, regardless of the bicycle standard.
- **ASTM F963.** The toy safety standard, mandatory in the US via 16 CFR 1250 since April 2024, covers small parts, sharp edges, and chemical limits, and often applies to balance bikes marketed as toddler toys.

## What this means for balance bike buyers

Two practical consequences:

1. **For EU-market bikes, 2026 and 2027 are a transition window.** A bike certified to the old EN 71-1 edition is not automatically non-compliant — but a bike tested to the 2026 edition has passed balance-bike-specific stability, strength, and handlebar-end tests that the old edition did not require. If a seller cites EN 71-1 compliance, ask which edition.
2. **For US buyers, the classification question decides which certificate to ask for:** a Children's Product Certificate (CPC) referencing 16 CFR 1512, ASTM F963, or both. Any legitimate seller can produce one.

## How to verify a bike in five minutes

1. Find the tracking label on the bike: manufacturer, location, date, batch.
2. Ask the seller for the Children's Product Certificate (US) or Declaration of Conformity (EU), and check which standard edition it cites.
3. Check the recall databases: CPSC in the US, Safety Gate in the EU. Our [balance bike recall record](/guides/risk/balance-bike-recall-record) tracks both.

Our [safety standards reference page](/balance-bike-safety-standards/) walks through the US and EU rule sets in plain language, with the verification steps for each.

zh.title: 2026 儿童骑乘玩具安全标准更新
zh.content:
多年来儿童骑乘玩具安全规则最大的一次变动今年落在欧洲，而且平衡车第一次被纳入一套专门的测试条款。以下是大西洋两岸各发生了什么、对平衡车具体意味着什么，以及怎么对照现行规则核查一辆车。

## 欧洲：EN 71-1:2026 给平衡车单列条款

2026 年 1 月 28 日，欧洲标准化委员会（CEN）向各成员国分发了新版 EN 71-1——欧盟玩具安全标准中机械与物理性能的那一半。它替代 EN 71-1:2014+A1:2018。

对本网站最重要的变化：乘骑玩具——自行车、平衡车、滑板车——被并入单一条款（8.21），下辖十一个子条款，其中五项是新测试：

1. **把端冲击。**车把每一端对硬表面撞击十次。
2. **刹车性能。**刹车按力值表判定，分步施加 40、50、60 牛的输入力，而不是测单一距离。
3. **把立安全性。**以 10 N·m 扭矩保持一分钟。
4. **辅轮强度。**每个辅轮承压 300 牛，有形变量与永久变形限值。
5. **鞍座与座管安全性。**鞍座承受 200 牛垂直载荷。

平衡车具体获得了旧版标准未写明的要求：间隙尺寸、前轮最小直径、车把尺寸、刹车要求、可调节把立与座管的最小插入深度标记、夹紧要求，以及稳定性加静态和动态强度测试——同时新增了警告语、标识与使用维护说明的要求。

时间线：各国标准机构应在 2026 年 7 月 31 日前采纳 EN 71-1:2026，冲突的旧国标最晚 2027 年 7 月 31 日废止。该版本预计在发布约十二个月后获欧盟委员会批准，届时成为玩具安全指令 2009/48/EC 下的协调标准——那才是在欧盟市场具有法律效力的版本。在获批之前，CE 标志依据的是旧版及其修订案。

## 美国：2026 年无大修，但要知道你的车归哪类

美国联邦规则今年没有变化。对买家重要的是理解一辆平衡车适用哪些规则——而这并不显然，因为平衡车没有脚踏：

- **人行道自行车。**CPSC 通常把座高 25 英寸（63.5 cm）以内的平衡车视为 16 CFR 1512 下的"人行道自行车"。该归类减少——但不取消——要求。
- **CPSIA。**铅限值（涂层 90 ppm、基材 100 ppm）、邻苯二甲酸盐限值和永久追溯标签适用于所有儿童产品，包括平衡车，与自行车标准无关。
- **ASTM F963。**玩具安全标准，自 2024 年 4 月起在美国经 16 CFR 1250 强制适用，覆盖小零件、锐边和化学限值，通常适用于作为幼儿玩具销售的平衡车。

## 对平衡车买家意味着什么

两个实际后果：

1. **对欧盟市场的车，2026 和 2027 是过渡窗口。**按旧版 EN 71-1 认证的车不会自动不合规——但按 2026 版测试过的车，通过了旧版不要求的平衡车专项稳定性、强度和把端测试。如果卖家援引 EN 71-1 合规，问清是哪一版。
2. **对美国买家，归类问题决定你该要哪种证书：**引用 16 CFR 1512、ASTM F963 或两者的儿童产品证书（CPC）。任何正规卖家都能出具。

## 五分钟核查一辆车

1. 找车上的追溯标签：厂商、地点、日期、批次。
2. 向卖家索要儿童产品证书（美国）或符合性声明（欧盟），并核对引用的标准版本。
3. 查召回数据库：美国 CPSC、欧盟 Safety Gate。我们的[平衡车召回记录](/guides/risk/balance-bike-recall-record)同时跟踪两者。

我们的[安全标准参考页](/balance-bike-safety-standards/)用平实语言梳理美欧规则集，并附每条的核查步骤。

en.title: What Research Says About Balance Bikes
en.content:
Balance bikes are often described as "research-backed." The research is real, it is recent, and it is thinner than the marketing suggests. Here is what the published studies actually measured, what they found, and what they have not shown.

## What the studies measured

The English-language literature on balance bikes is small and concentrated. Two peer-reviewed studies from the same Portuguese research group do most of the work.

The [2022 study in the International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health](https://www.mdpi.com/1660-4601/19/3/1814) analyzed 2,005 parent responses collected in Portugal between November 2019 and June 2020. Its outcome measure was learning age — the age at which a child first cycled independently. Children whose first bike was a balance bike averaged 4.16 years; those who started with training wheels averaged 5.97; those who started directly on a pedal bike averaged 7.27. The differences were statistically significant.

The [2025 study in the Journal of Functional Morphology and Kinesiology](https://www.mdpi.com/2411-5142/10/1/53) was an intervention: 50 children who could not yet cycle practiced for six sessions on either a balance bike or a training-wheel bike, then moved to a conventional bicycle. Independent-cycling success was 100% in the balance-bike group and about 77% in the training-wheels group. Balance-bike learners were faster at each milestone: self-launch, riding, and braking.

## What the research says, stated carefully

Taken together, the studies support a narrow claim: when a balance bike is a child's first bike, they tend to reach independent cycling sooner than children who start with training wheels. The 2025 authors also found that children with higher BMI percentiles took longer to reach balance milestones — a finding about the sample, not a claim about any individual child.

## What the research has not shown

This is the part that gets skipped in product marketing. The honest gaps:

- **No long-term skill or safety outcomes.** Neither study followed children to see whether balance-bike starters ride more safely, enjoy cycling more, or crash less years later.
- **Small and regional samples.** The 2025 study included 50 children from one region; peer reviewers specifically questioned the baseline equivalence of its groups and the strength of its body-composition conclusions.
- **Self-reported data in the 2022 study.** Families chose their own tools, so household factors — not just the bike — may explain part of the gap.
- **No dose-response evidence.** Nobody has published a study showing how many hours of balance-bike practice produce what outcome.
- **A young literature.** Both studies come from one research group; independent replication by other groups is still limited.

"Balance bikes help children learn to cycle sooner" is what the evidence currently supports. Anything stronger — developmental advantages, athletic benefits, safety improvements — is ahead of the data.

## How to use this as a parent

The practical reading is simple: start with a balance bike that fits, ride it regularly, and do not stress about the timeline. The average in the 2022 survey is just over four years to independent cycling, but the spread around that average is wide. For fit specifics, our [balance bike by age](/balance-bike-by-age/) guide covers the inseam-to-seat measurement that matters more than any study.

zh.title: 研究怎么看平衡车
zh.content:
平衡车常被描述为"有研究背书"。研究是真的，很新，也比营销暗示的更薄。以下是已发表研究实际测量了什么、发现了什么，以及没有证明什么。

## 研究测了什么

平衡车的英文文献很少且集中。大多数工作由同一支葡萄牙研究团队的两项同行评审研究完成。

[2022 年发表于《国际环境研究与公共卫生杂志》的研究](https://www.mdpi.com/1660-4601/19/3/1814)分析了 2019 年 11 月至 2020 年 6 月在葡萄牙收集的 2005 份家长回复。其结果指标是"学会年龄"——孩子首次独立骑车的年龄。第一辆车是平衡车的孩子平均 4.16 岁；从训练轮起步的平均 5.97 岁；直接上脚踏车的平均 7.27 岁。差异具有统计显著性。

[2025 年发表于《功能形态学与运动学杂志》的研究](https://www.mdpi.com/2411-5142/10/1/53)是一项干预实验：50 名还不会骑车的孩子在平衡车或训练轮车上练习六个课时，然后转到普通自行车。独立骑行成功率在平衡车组为 100%，训练轮组约 77%。平衡车组在每个里程碑上都更快：自主起步、骑行、刹车。

## 研究说了什么，谨慎地陈述

合起来，这些研究支持一个狭窄的结论：当平衡车是孩子的第一辆车时，他们往往比从训练轮起步的孩子更早达到独立骑行。2025 年研究还发现 BMI 百分位较高的孩子达到平衡里程碑更慢——这是关于样本的发现，不是对任何个体孩子的宣称。

## 研究没有证明什么

这是产品营销里最常被跳过的一段。诚实的空白：

- **没有长期技能或安全结果。**两项研究都没有追踪孩子多年，看平衡车起步者是否骑得更安全、更享受骑行、或更少摔车。
- **样本小且地域单一。**2025 年研究只有 50 名孩子，来自同一地区；同行评审人明确质疑过两组起点的等价性及其身体构成结论的强度。
- **2022 年研究是自报数据。**家庭自己选择工具，所以家庭因素——不只是车——可能解释了一部分差距。
- **没有剂量-效应证据。**没有人发表过"练多少小时产生什么结果"的研究。
- **文献年轻。**两项研究出自同一个团队；其他团队的独立复现仍然有限。

"平衡车帮助孩子更早学会骑车"是现有证据支持的表述。任何更强的说法——发育优势、运动能力收益、安全改善——都跑在了数据前面。

## 家长怎么用这些信息

实际读法很简单：从一辆合适的平衡车开始，规律地骑，别为时间线焦虑。2022 年调查里独立骑行的均值是刚过四岁，但围绕这个均值的分布很宽。适配细节见我们的[平衡车按年龄选](/balance-bike-by-age/)指南——腿长量座高这件事，比任何研究都重要。

en.title: New Balance Bike Launches: 2026 Roundup
en.content:
2026 brought the first genuinely new balance bike from the category's best-known brand in nearly a decade, plus a notable entry from the premium end. Here are the launches with public, dated spec sheets — and what each change means for fit.

## Strider 12 Comp — the first new Strider model since 2017

Strider, the South Dakota brand that effectively created the modern balance bike category, announced the 12 Comp in April 2026 — its first new model since 2017. The headline spec is the frame: nylon composite, bringing the complete weight down to 4.9 lb (2.2 kg), the lightest 12-inch bike in Strider's line.

The published numbers:

- **Weight:** 4.9 lb (2.2 kg)
- **Wheel size:** 12 inches, with EVA foam "Ultralight" wheels; optional pneumatic High-Traction wheels
- **Inseam fit:** 12–16 in (30.5–40.6 cm)
- **Seat height:** 11–15 in (27.9–38.1 cm), adjustable with a snap-to-adjust clip
- **Handlebar:** fixed at 19 in (48.3 cm)
- **Ages:** 1–3 years; maximum rider weight 45 lb (20 kg)
- **MSRP:** $139.99

What it means for fit: the 12 Comp slots below the steel 12 Sport (about 6.7 lb) and the aluminum 12 Pro (about 5.6 lb) in Strider's lineup, with the lightest weight at a mid price. The trade-offs are a fixed handlebar height and a shorter seat range (11–15 in versus up to 17–19 in on the Sport and Pro), which shortens useful life. The composite frame is new for the brand, so long-term durability data does not exist yet — a fair thing to weigh for a bike that might serve two kids.

## Micro Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome — listed as new for 2026

Micro, the Swiss scooter brand, has a new top-of-the-range balance bike listed for 2026 by retailers: the Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome. Its distinguishing feature is dynamo-powered LED wheel rims that light up as the bike rolls — no batteries. Under the novelty:

- **Weight:** 3.2 kg (about 7 lb)
- **Frame:** lightweight magnesium
- **Wheels:** 12-inch PU foam, puncture-free
- **Saddle:** adjustable, 33.5–40 cm from the ground
- **Ages:** listed from 18 months; retailer listings describe a 2–5 year target
- **Maximum rider weight:** 50 kg
- **Low step-through frame; traditional alloy headset**

What it means for fit: magnesium at this weight is genuinely light for the price class, and the low step-through helps younger riders mount independently. The saddle range tops out at 40 cm (about 15.7 in), so check that against your child's inseam — and note the older target rider than the Strider.

## The pattern worth noticing

Both 2026 launches push on the same two specs: weight and step-through access. That is a real shift — the category's center of gravity has moved from "survive a toddler" to "let a toddler handle the bike themselves." Frame materials are diversifying too: composite (Strider) and magnesium (Micro) join steel and aluminum, which means buyers now have a genuine material trade-off to make rather than a default.

## How to read a launch

When a new model lands, the spec sheet tells you less than it seems. Focus on three numbers: weight relative to your child, the seat range against their inseam, and the wheel type for your main surface. Everything else — colors, accessories, marketing — is decoration. Our [balance bike size chart](/balance-bike-size-chart/) shows how the new seat ranges compare against the current field.

2026 年，这个品类最知名的品牌推出了近十年来的第一款真正意义上的新平衡车，高端段也有值得一看的新品。以下是发布信息公开、有日期可查的几款新品——以及每个变化对适配的意义。

## Strider 12 Comp——Strider 2017 年以来首款新车型

Strider，这家实际上开创了现代平衡车品类的南达科他品牌，于 2026 年 4 月发布了 12 Comp——这是它 2017 年以来的第一款新车型。头条规格是车架：尼龙复合材质，把整车重量拉到 4.9 磅（2.2 公斤），是 Strider 产品线里最轻的 12 寸车。

公开数字：

- **重量：**4.9 磅（2.2 公斤）
- **轮径：**12 寸，EVA 发泡"Ultralight"轮；可选充气 High-Traction 轮
- **腿长适配：**12–16 英寸（30.5–40.6 cm）
- **座高：**11–15 英寸（27.9–38.1 cm），卡扣式快调
- **车把：**固定 19 英寸（48.3 cm）
- **年龄：**1–3 岁；最大骑手重量 45 磅（20 kg）
- **建议零售价：**139.99 美元

对适配的意义：12 Comp 卡在钢架 12 Sport（约 6.7 磅）和铝架 12 Pro（约 5.6 磅）之间，以中档价格给出最轻重量。代价是车把高度固定、座高范围更短（11–15 英寸，而 Sport/Pro 可达 17–19 英寸），这缩短了有效使用期。复合车架对该品牌是新材料，长期耐久数据尚不存在——对一辆可能要服务两个孩子的车，这是值得权衡的一点。

## Micro Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome——零售商列为 2026 新款

瑞士滑板车品牌 Micro 有一款被零售商列为 2026 年新款的新旗舰平衡车：Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome。它的辨识特征是花鼓发电的 LED 轮圈，骑起来就亮——不用电池。新意之下：

- **重量：**3.2 公斤（约 7 磅）
- **车架：**轻量化镁合金
- **轮子：**12 寸 PU 发泡，防扎
- **座垫：**可调，离地 33.5–40 cm
- **年龄：**列明 18 个月起；零售商描述的目标人群为 2–5 岁
- **最大骑手重量：**50 公斤
- **低横梁车架；传统合金头碗**

对适配的意义：镁合金在这个价位段确实够轻，低横梁帮助更小的骑手独立上下车。座垫范围上限 40 cm（约 15.7 英寸），请对照孩子的腿长核对——并注意它面向的骑手比 Strider 更大。

## 值得注意的规律

两款 2026 新品推的是同两个规格：重量和低横梁上下车。这是一个真实转向——品类的重心从"扛过一个幼儿"移到了"让幼儿自己摆弄这辆车"。车架材质也在多样化：复合（Strider）和镁合金（Micro）加入了钢和铝的阵营，买家现在有真正的材质取舍可做，而不是默认项。

## 怎么读一次发布

新车型落地时，规格表告诉你的比看起来少。盯三个数字：相对于你孩子的重量、对照腿长的座高范围、以及匹配主骑路面的轮胎类型。其余——颜色、配件、营销——都是装饰。我们的[平衡车尺码表](/balance-bike-size-chart/)展示了新座高范围与现役款式的对比。

en.title: Balance Bike Brand News — October 2026
en.content:
The balance bike world moved this year. Strider shipped its first new model since 2017, Micro's LED-wheeled balance bike reached retailers, and woom kept its limited-edition cadence going. Here is what happened and what it means for buyers.

## Strider: first new model since 2017

Strider Bikes announced the 12 Comp in April, and it is now broadly available at $139.99. It is the South Dakota brand's first new balance bike model since 2017 — a long gap for the company that effectively created the category.

The news for buyers is the frame: nylon composite, at 4.9 lb complete, the lightest 12-inch Strider to date. It slots under the steel 12 Sport and aluminum 12 Pro, with a fixed handlebar and a shorter seat range. Our [new-product roundup](/news/new_product/new-balance-bikes-2026/) covers the full spec sheet and the fit implications.

## Micro: LED wheels go dynamo

Micro's Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome is listed as new for 2026 by retailers. The gimmick is real engineering: dynamo-powered LED rims with no batteries. Under that, a magnesium frame at about 3.2 kg and a low step-through design put it in contention for lighter-riders-first buyers. See the spec breakdown in our [launches roundup](/news/new_product/new-balance-bikes-2026/).

## woom: limited editions keep coming

woom released neon lime and neon pink limited editions across its line in July, following a Power Pink edition earlier in the year. For balance-bike buyers, the relevant model is the woom GO 1: aluminum frame, 3 kg, 12-inch wheels, sized for roughly 1.5 to 3.5 years and 82–100 cm. Limited editions do not change specs — but they do mean current-season stock rotates quickly, and a color you want may be gone by the next season.

## woom moves up: the EXPLORE e

Also worth noting for brand watchers: woom launched the EXPLORE e globally in March, a pedal-assist e-bike for ages 7–14 with a MAHLE drive. It is not a balance bike and not relevant to toddler buyers, but it signals where the category's revenue is heading — established kids' bike brands are betting on the older, higher-margin end of the market.

## What it means for balance bike buyers

Three takeaways:

1. **Weight is the battleground.** Every 2026 launch story is a weight story: 4.9 lb composite, 3.2 kg magnesium. The light end of the market keeps getting lighter.
2. **Frame materials are diversifying.** Steel, aluminum, composite, and magnesium are all in play now — each with a different weight, cost, and durability profile.
3. **Big brands move slowly.** Strider's nine-year gap between models means the used and mid-market segments stay relevant far longer than in most categories.

We track new launches and brand moves as they land — the [new-product channel](/news/new_product/) is the place to watch for the next one, and our [balance bikes hub](/products/balance-bikes/) compares the current field.

zh.title: 平衡车品牌动态：2026 年 10 月
zh.content:
平衡车世界今年动作不少。Strider 推出了 2017 年以来的首款新车型，Micro 的 LED 轮平衡车进入零售渠道，woom 则保持着限量配色的节奏。以下是发生了什么，以及对买家意味着什么。

## Strider：2017 年以来首款新车型

Strider Bikes 于 4 月发布了 12 Comp，目前已在 139.99 美元价位广泛有货。这是这家南达科他品牌 2017 年以来的第一款新平衡车车型——对一家实际上开创了品类的公司来说，这个间隔很长。

对买家来说是车架的新闻：尼龙复合材质，整车 4.9 磅，是 Strider 迄今最轻的 12 寸车。它定位在钢架 12 Sport 与铝架 12 Pro 之间，车把固定、座高范围更短。我们的[新品盘点](/news/new_product/new-balance-bikes-2026/)覆盖完整规格表与适配影响。

## Micro：LED 轮改用花鼓发电

Micro 的 Balance Bike Ultra LED Neochrome 被零售商列为 2026 年新款。这个噱头是真工程：花鼓发电的 LED 轮圈，不用电池。在此之下，约 3.2 公斤的镁合金车架和低横梁设计，让它进入"轻者优先"买家的备选。规格拆解见我们的[新品盘点](/news/new_product/new-balance-bikes-2026/)。

## woom：限量配色不断

woom 7 月发布了荧光青绿和荧光粉限量配色，覆盖全线，此前年初还有过 Power Pink 版。对平衡车买家，相关车型是 woom GO 1：铝架、3 公斤、12 寸轮，面向约 1.5–3.5 岁、身高 82–100 cm。限量版不改规格——但意味着当季库存轮换很快，你想要的颜色下一季可能就没了。

## woom 向上走：EXPLORE e

关注品牌动向的还值得注意：woom 3 月在全球发布了 EXPLORE e，一款面向 7–14 岁、配 MAHLE 驱动的脚踏助力电助力车。它不是平衡车，与幼儿买家无关，但它预示了品类收入的走向——成熟的童车品牌正在押注更大龄、更高毛利的那一端。

## 对平衡车买家意味着什么

三个要点：

1. **重量是战场。**2026 年每个发布故事都是重量故事：4.9 磅复合、3.2 公斤镁合金。市场的轻端越来越轻。
2. **车架材质在多样化。**钢、铝、复合、镁合金现在都在牌桌上——各有不同的重量、成本与耐久表现。
3. **大品牌动作慢。**Strider 九年才换一次代，意味着二手和中端市场的生命力比大多数品类持续得更久。

我们跟踪每一次新品发布和品牌动作——[新品频道](/news/new_product/)是看下一场发布的地方，我们的[平衡车品类页](/products/balance-bikes/)对比现役全场。

zh.title: 如何选择与正确使用儿童安全座椅
zh.content:
带孩子出行，安全永远是第一位的。在车辆行驶过程中，急刹车或碰撞产生的冲击力对儿童来说可能是毁灭性的，而儿童安全座椅（Child Safety Seat）则是保护孩子生命安全的最后一道防线。

1. 为什么要必须使用安全座椅？

汽车上的成人安全带是根据成年人的身高和骨骼发育设计的。当发生碰撞时，成人安全带不仅无法有效束缚儿童，反而勒住孩子的颈部或腹部，造成严重的二次伤害。据美国 NHTSA 数据，正确使用安全座椅能将婴儿的死亡率降低70%以上，幼儿死亡率降低50%以上。

2. 如何根据年龄与体重选择？

安全座椅通常按儿童的年龄、身高或体重进行分组：

* 		婴儿提篮式（反向安装）： 适合新生儿至15个月左右的婴儿。反向安装能最有效地分散撞击时对婴儿脆弱颈椎和头部的冲击。

* 		成长型座椅（正向/反向切换）： 适合1岁至4岁或更大会员。建议尽量让孩子保持反向乘坐，直到超出座椅的反向限值。

* 		增高垫配合安全带： 适合4岁至12岁、身高达到一定标准的儿童，主要用于垫高身体，让车载安全带正确跨过儿童的肩膀和骨盆。


3. 常见的几个安装与使用误区

* 		误区一：抱着孩子坐在后排。 事故发生瞬间，家长的手臂根本无法承受数十倍的冲击力，孩子极易飞出或成为家长的“安全气囊”。

* 		误区二：只装不固定或安全带过松。 安装时必须使用 ISOFIX 接口或安全带固定牢固，晃动幅度不应超过3厘米。

en.title: Choosing and Using Child Safety Seats
en.content:
When traveling with children, safety always comes first. The impact force from sudden braking or collisions can be devastating to a child, making the child safety seat the ultimate line of defense for their lives.

1. Why is a Safety Seat Essential?

Adult seatbelts in cars are designed based on adult heights and skeletal development. During a collision, standard seatbelts fail to restrain children properly and can instead choke or injure their necks and abdomens. NHTSA estimates that properly using a safety seat reduces infant mortality by over 70% and toddler mortality by over 50%.

2. How to Choose Based on Age and Weight?

Safety seats are generally categorized by age, height, or weight groups:

* 		Rear-Facing Infant Car Seats: Suitable for newborns up to about 15 months. Rear-facing installation most effectively disperses impact forces on an infant's fragile neck and head.

* 		Convertible Seats: Suitable for toddlers up to 4 years and older. It is recommended to keep children rear-facing as long as possible until they exceed the limit.

* 		High-Back Booster Seats: Suitable for children aged 4 to 12 who have reached specific height requirements, elevating them so the vehicle seatbelt crosses correctly over the shoulder and pelvis.

3. Common Installation and Usage Mistakes

* 		Mistake 1: Holding the child in the back seat. During a crash, a parent's arms cannot withstand tens of times the impact force, making the child prone to flying out.

* 		Mistake 2: Loose installation or loose harness straps. Seats must be rigidly secured using ISOFIX connectors or seatbelts, with no more than 2-3 cm of movement.

zh.content:
Kellys 是一个主要的欧洲自行车品牌， 于 1991 年在斯洛伐克创立，但在美国很少见到。Strider 的一位发言人告诉 BRAIN，Strider 不会批发 Kellys 的车型。 

“我们一直在寻找一款完美的自行车，以便在孩子们从Strider毕业后推荐给他们，”Strider创始人兼首席执行官Ryan McFarland说道。“Kellys的儿童自行车系列非常完美，因为它们与我们的热情和价值观相契合，并且与我们的自行车有很多相同的特点——它们轻便、可靠、易于维护，并且配备了专为儿童设计的部件，让骑行充满乐趣。”

Strider 将销售三款 Kellys 型号：Kellys NAGA Air Belt、Kellys NAGA Air 50 和 Kellys NAGA Air 70 Disc。

Kellys NAGA Air Belt 提供 18 英寸和 20 英寸轮径两种型号。Kellys NAGA Air 50 配备 7 速变速系统，提供 20 英寸和 24 英寸轮径两种型号。Kellys NAGA Air 70 Disc 也提供 20 英寸和 24 英寸轮径两种型号。

en.title: Strider Bikes now selling Kellys juvenile models
en.content:
RAPID CITY, S.D. (BRAIN) — Strider Bikes is now the exclusive authorized retailer for Kellys children's bikes in the United States.


Kellys is a major European bike brand, founded in Slovakia in 1991, but rarely seen in the U.S. A Strider spokesperson told BRAIN that Strider will not be wholesaling Kellys models. 

"We've searched for a long time to find the perfect bike to recommend for kids once they graduate from Strider," said Strider's Founder and CEO Ryan McFarland. "Kellys' line of children's bikes are perfect because they align with our passion and values, and share a lot of the same features as our bikes — they're lightweight, dependable, low maintenance, and feature kid-specific components that keep riding fun."

Strider will be selling three Kellys models: the Kellys NAGA Air Belt, the Kellys NAGA Air 50, and the Kellys NAGA Air 70 Disc.

The Kellys NAGA Air Belt is available in 18-inch and 20-inch wheel models. The Kellys NAGA Air 50 has a 7-speed drivetrain, and is available in 20-inch and 24-inch models. The Kellys NAGA Air 70 Disc is also available in 20-inch and 24-inch wheel models.

zh.title: 折叠电动滑板车（Foldable Electric Scooter）世界知名品牌汇总
zh.content:
折叠电动滑板车（Foldable Electric Scooter）在全球范围内市场发展非常成熟，根据定位（通勤、性价比、高性能、超轻量）的不同，全球知名的代表性品牌可以划分为以下几个梯队：

1. 国际一线与市场主导品牌（大众通勤首选）

九号 / 九号机器人 (Segway-Ninebot)

* 品牌背景： 全球电动滑板车领域的“巨无霸”，收购了老牌电动平衡车鼻祖 Segway，产品销量连续多年位居全球前列。 

* 特点： 极高的耐用性、优秀的算法与App智能互联、做工扎实。 

* 代表折叠系列： Ninebot MAX 系列（如 G30P、MAX G2，全球最耐造的通勤神器）、F系列、E2系列。
小米 (Xiaomi)

* 品牌背景： 早期与九号合作，将折叠电动滑板车推向全球普及的功臣，在欧洲及东南亚市场占有率极高。

* 特点： 极高的性价比、简洁的极简工业设计、折叠机构成熟且配件极易购买。 

* 代表折叠系列： Xiaomi Electric Scooter 4 系列、Pro 系列。 


小牛电动 (NIU)

* 品牌背景： 以高端智能电动两轮车起家，近几年推出的微出行（滑板车）系列在北美和欧洲大受欢迎。 

* 特点： 宽踏板、宽轮胎设计（骑行舒适度极高），车架刚性极强，具备汽车级电池管理与防盗系统。 

* 代表折叠系列： KQi 系列（如 KQi2 Pro, KQi3 Pro, KQi Air 碳纤维超轻版）。


2. 欧美高端与性能品牌（注重设计与动力）

Apollo Scooters（加拿大）

* 品牌背景： 来自加拿大的高端电动滑板车品牌，在北美知名度极高。

* 特点： 专为复杂路况和长途设计，拥有优秀的双动力电机、自研App、高级悬挂系统和极致的工业外观设计。

* 代表折叠系列： Apollo City、Apollo Pro、Apollo Air。 


Unagi（美国）

* 品牌背景： 欧美极简风与科技感代表，以“极简时尚”和“订阅制租用模式”闻名。

* 特点： 车体采用碳纤维、镁合金和航空级铝合金打造，外观看不见外露线缆，一键折叠，极其轻便。 

* 代表折叠系列： Unagi Model One Voyage。 


Gotrax（美国）

* 品牌背景： 北美亚马逊及沃尔玛的常年销量冠军品牌之一。

* 特点： 主打平民性价比、实用主义，是许多欧美学生党和上班族入门的第一台折叠滑板车。 

* 代表折叠系列： G4、GXL V2。 


3. 极速与越野性能品牌（Performance / Super Scooters）

如果你追求 50km/h 以上的高速、双电机双驱、强悍越野悬挂 以及折叠后能放进后备箱的“性能怪兽”，以下品牌是全球玩家的避坑首选：

品牌	产地 / 背景	特点与定位	代表折叠车型
Dualtron (迷你直通)	韩国 / 浙江	全球性能滑板车领域的鼻祖与标杆，动力极其恐怖，改装潜力巨大。	Dualtron Thunder, Victor, Mini
Kaabo (钛动/狼咏)	中国 (面向全球)	欧洲与澳洲越野玩家最爱，专攻高性价比双电机越野折叠车。	Mantis X Plus, Wolf Warrior 系列
Vsett	国际知名品牌	设计感强、带有 NFC 刷卡解锁，转向与避震系统在性能圈口碑极佳。	Vsett 9+, Vsett 10+
NAMI	高端定制性能	专为玩家打造的超高性能滑板车，全水压焊接车架，悬挂极舒适。	NAMI Burn-E 2

💡 选购建议

1. 便携 / 进地铁 / 办公室放脚下： 优先考虑重量在 $12\text{--}15\text{ kg}$ 左右的车型，如 Xiaomi Electric Scooter 或 Unagi Model One。 

2. 日常通勤 / 破损路面 / 耐用度： 推荐重量在 $18\text{--}24\text{ kg}$ 且带避震的车型，如 Segway-Ninebot MAX G2 或 NIU KQi3 Pro。 

3. 爬陡坡 / 追求极速与远航程： 建议选择重量 $30\text{ kg}+$ 的双电机车型，如 Apollo City Dual、Kaabo Mantis 或 Dualtron。

en.title: Foldable Electric Scooter Brands Worldwide
en.content:
The global market for foldable electric scooters is highly mature. Based on different market positioning (daily commuting, value-for-money, high performance, ultra-lightweight), the world-renowned representative brands can be categorized into the following tiers:

1. Top International & Market-Leading Brands (Best for Mass Commuting)
Segway-Ninebot

* Background: The global giant in the electric scooter industry. It acquired Segway, the original pioneer of self-balancing transporters, and its global sales volume has ranked among the top for years.

* Features: Exceptional durability, excellent algorithm & app integration, and solid build quality.

* Key Foldable Series: Ninebot MAX Series (e.g., G30P, MAX G2—known globally as the ultimate durable commuter workhorse), F Series, and E2 Series.


Xiaomi

* Background: An early partner of Ninebot, Xiaomi played a pivotal role in popularizing foldable electric scooters globally. It holds a dominant market share in Europe and Southeast Asia.

* Features: Excellent cost-to-performance ratio, minimalist industrial design, mature folding mechanisms, and readily available spare parts.

* Key Foldable Series: Xiaomi Electric Scooter 4 Series, Pro Series.
NIU Technologies

* Background: Originally famous for smart electric mopeds, NIU's micro-mobility lineup has gained immense popularity in North America and Europe in recent years.

* Features: Wide deck and wide tires (offering high riding comfort), strong frame rigidity, automotive-grade Battery Management Systems (BMS), and anti-theft features.

* Key Foldable Series: KQi Series (e.g., KQi2 Pro, KQi3 Pro, KQi Air ultra-light carbon fiber version).


2. Western Premium & Performance Brands (Design & Power Focused)

Apollo Scooters (Canada)

* Background: A high-end electric scooter brand from Canada with strong brand recognition in North America.

* Features: Designed for complex terrain and long-distance rides. Equipped with dual motors, proprietary app features, advanced suspension systems, and sleek industrial designs.

* Key Foldable Series: Apollo City, Apollo Pro, Apollo Air.

Unagi (USA)

* Background: A representative of minimalist style and tech aesthetics in Western markets, famous for its sleek design and "subscription rental" model.

* Features: Built with carbon fiber, magnesium alloy, and aircraft-grade aluminum. Hidden cables, one-click folding, and extremely lightweight.

* Key Foldable Series: Unagi Model One Voyage.
Gotrax (USA)

* Background: One of the perennial top-selling brands on Amazon and Walmart in North America.

* Features: Focuses on budget-friendliness and practicality. A popular choice for students and commuters buying their first foldable scooter.

* Key Foldable Series: G4, GXL V2.


3. High-Speed & Off-Road Performance Brands (Super Scooters)

If you are looking for speeds over 50 km/h, dual-motor drives, heavy-duty off-road suspension, and "performance beasts" that can still fold up to fit into a car trunk, these global brands are top choices for enthusiasts:

Brand	Origin / Background	Features & Positioning	Key Foldable Models

Dualtron (Minimotors)	South Korea / China	The pioneer and benchmark in performance scooters. Known for 
immense power and high customization potential.	Dualtron Thunder, Victor, Mini

Kaabo	China (Global Focus)	A favorite among off-road riders in Europe and Australia, specializing in high-value dual-motor off-road foldable scooters.	Mantis X Plus, Wolf Warrior Series

Vsett	Internationally Renowned	Stylish design with NFC card unlock. Renowned in the enthusiast community for excellent steering and suspension systems.	Vsett 9+, Vsett 10+

NAMI	Premium Custom Performance	High-end performance scooters built for enthusiast riders, featuring hydroformed frames and ultra-comfortable hydraulic suspension.	NAMI Burn-E 2
💡 Buyer's Guide

1. Portability / Subway Commuting / Desk Storage: Prioritize lightweight models around $12\text{--}15\text{ kg}$, such as the Xiaomi Electric Scooter or Unagi Model One.

2. Daily Commuting / Rough Roads / Durability: Opt for models weighing $18\text{--}24\text{ kg}$ equipped with suspension, such as the Segway-Ninebot MAX G2 or NIU KQi3 Pro.

3. Steep Hills / High Speed / Long Range: Consider dual-motor models weighing $30\text{ kg}+$, such as the Apollo City Dual, Kaabo Mantis, or Dualtron.
